# Sits above nothing: a blank line follows.

# Parses recipes.
module Kapi
  # The largest recipe.
  LIMIT = 10

  # Reads a recipe.
  #
  # @param source [String] the recipe's text
  # @return [Parser] a parser
  class Parser
    attr_reader :source # a trailing comment

    # Makes a parser.
    def initialize(source)
      # Inside the method.
      @source = source
    end

    # Runs the parser.
    def self.run = new("x")
  end
end

# A helper at the top of the file.
def helper; end

cask "kapi-desktop" do
  # The app's summary.
  desc "Desktop workbench"
end
